page.text: This method sends a message to the chat of the group call, visible to every participant. In end-to-end encrypted conference calls the message is encrypted with the call key before being sent.
page.syntax-highlight: from pytgcalls import PyTgCalls from pytgcalls import idle ... app = PyTgCalls(client) app.start() ... # Call API methods app.send_message( -1001185324811, 'Now playing: Lena Raine - Resurrections 🍓 Madeline finally hatched 🐣', ) idle()

subtext.text: Send a message to the group call chat.
Telegram Stars to pay to send the message, required when the group call has a minimum price for messages.
The sent message, or None when both text and stars are empty.
